svg.title: Requests per second: platform-bun on Bun against platform-node on Node and on Bun
svg.desc: Controllers benchmark, GET /: platform-bun on Bun 168,973, platform-node on Node 138,950, platform-node on Bun 146,138. Controllers benchmark, GET /users/42: platform-bun on Bun 164,032, platform-node on Node 131,014, platform-node on Bun 136,205. Controllers benchmark, POST /echo: platform-bun on Bun 126,202, platform-node on Node 102,458, platform-node on Bun 113,978. Nest's benchmark, GET /: platform-bun on Bun 194,193, platform-node on Node 172,841, platform-node on Bun 153,606.
svg.text: Requests per second, higher is better
